# TeachAssist

> A free, student-made dashboard for York Region (YRDSB) students that turns TeachAssist marks into a clear view of every evaluation and the Knowledge, Thinking, Communication and Application breakdown. Independent project, not run by YRDSB.

## Pages

- [Home and sign-in](https://teachassist.pages.dev/): Sign in with a YRDSB student number or explore the demo with sample data
- [Privacy](https://teachassist.pages.dev/legal/privacy.html): How student credentials and marks are handled
- [Terms](https://teachassist.pages.dev/legal/terms.html): Terms of use
